records.name: Community Board Game Night at Philly Game Shop
records.summary: A free open board game night at Philly Game Shop every Saturday evening. Walk in, take a seat at a table, and play with other people who come to the shop.
records.what_you_do: Walk in, find a table, and play board games with other players.

first_step.how: Walk in during the event. The shop's Discord sign-up guide is also linked from its events page.
first_step.basis: The page says walk-in seating is free and gives a clear way to join.

records.notes: Weekly program listed on the shop's own events page. The page shows no dates, so status is probably_active rather than active. Search snippets gave 519 South 5th Street, but the shop's page lists 521 to 525 South 5th Street, which is used here.

records.name: Sungayz! Queer Game Night at Philly Game Shop
records.summary: A weekly game night for queer players at Philly Game Shop on Sunday evenings. Walk in and play board games with other people from the community.
records.what_you_do: Walk in, find a table, and play games with other queer players.

schedule.text: Sundays from 5 pm until the shop closes at 9 pm, every week

first_step.how: Walk in, or use the shop's Discord sign-up guide.
first_step.basis: The page says walk-in seating is free and invites people to come in.

records.notes: Name is as published on the shop's events page. The page shows no dates, so status is probably_active.

first_step.how: Walk in during the session. The shop's Discord sign-up guide is also linked.
first_step.basis: The page says walk-in seating is free and open to anyone.

first_step.how: Walk in, or use the shop's Discord sign-up guide.

records.name: D&D 101 and One-Shot D&D Sessions at Philly Game Shop
records.summary: Dungeons and Dragons games at Philly Game Shop on Sunday afternoons, including sessions called D&D 101 and one-shot games. Email the staff to check whether a seat is open.

records.notes: Drop-in status is not stated, since seats are checked with staff first. The page shows no dates, so status is probably_active.

records.name: Crochet Circle at Lutheran Settlement House
records.summary: A weekly crochet circle at the Lutheran Settlement House Fishtown office for adults 55 and older. Volunteer instructors help people make friends, get better at crochet, or learn from the start.
records.what_you_do: Come on a Thursday morning to crochet with others and get help from volunteer instructors. No registration is needed.

first_step.how: Go to the Fishtown office on a Thursday morning. No registration is needed.
first_step.basis: The page says the circle is open to anyone 55 and older, welcomes people who want to learn to crochet, and needs no registration.

records.notes: Run by a settlement house, not a shop. Added because it turned up while searching for yarn circles, so it may also come in through another lane; merge by website. The page lists the next session on 2026-10-08.

notes: Scope: the named bookstores, plus yarn, game and comic shops. Records written: 6. Five are weekly open-play or social programs at Philly Game Shop (521 to 525 South 5th Street, Queen Village), all read from the shop's own events page, which shows weekly schedules but no dates, so all are probably_active. One is a Lutheran Settlement House crochet circle, which is not a shop but was found while searching for yarn circles and was read from its own page (2026 date). Checked, no record: Uncle Bobbie's (events page lists only a Free Library author series and one-off ticketed events); Harriett's Bookshop (redirected to oursisterbookshops.com, where the events are one-off readings from 2021 to 2024 across sister shops); Head House Books (one-off readings only, one postponed, no recurring group); Big Blue Marble (annual fairs and one-off events only, no book club page at /book-club); A Novel Idea on Passyunk (site is anovelideaphilly.com; its book clubs are paid monthly book purchases and its monthly tarot program is paid, so no free recurring group; its 2019 community writing group is absent from the current events page, so not recorded). Note that anovelideabooks.com is a different shop in Ocala, Florida, and was not used. Brickbat Books, Giovanni's Room, Philly AIDS Thrift, Bindlestiff Books, Fantom Comics, Thirsty Dice and Brave New Worlds are listed under blocked. Yarn: no yarn shop with a knitting or crochet circle was found. The Athenaeum of Philadelphia knitting circle (first Saturday monthly, 219 South 6th Street) has only a September 7, 2024 listing, and its current site shows no knitting circle, so not recorded. The Free Library fiber arts clubs (Whitman, Wyoming, Frankford, Roxborough) are library programs outside this lane and were not fetched. Skipped as instructed: Redcap's Corner, Queen and Rook, Drinks and Dragons, Philly Knits. Not checked: The Head and The Hand (Fishtown community shop and publisher, with a Write Nite listed on a 2019 calendar). It appeared in search, but no working URL was confirmed, so it is not in leads_only. Search budget: 3 of 3 used, cap reached. Fetches: 38. No rate limiting seen apart from the TLS and DNS failures listed above.
